continuity: The old assassin Jin encountered may be the One-Legged Ghost Killer, a famed Qinghai assassin reputed to have killed a Supreme Peak Kunlun Elder; Namho says the identification is uncertain and the assassin had a prosthetic leg.
The old assassin is currently an ally expected to fight alongside the group, but Jin is troubled by that alliance and intends to ask Ma Sanbao why he brought the assassins into the cause.
Jin reflects that he has killed people without seeking alternatives and is trying to become better; he does not consider himself a good person.
The grand banquet and a possible decisive battle remain ahead; the enemy's confidence in victory remains unexplained.
Ma Sanbao's possible role in recruiting assassins remains unresolved; the old assassin himself disclosed a connection to Ma Sanbao.
plot: Jin asks Sama Pyo and the Divine Physician about their ties to assassins. The Divine Physician recalls his Master, the former Slaughter Saint, and Sama Pyo and Namho connect the old assassin Jin encountered to the feared One-Legged Ghost Killer, though Namho says the identification is uncertain and the man is currently an ally. Jin struggles with the moral cost of joining forces with a killer who takes lives for money, then sets out to ask Ma Sanbao why he brought the assassins into the cause.
The Divine Physician recounts that his Master destroyed Salcheonmun because its members felt no regret or remorse for their deeds.
translation_decisions: Render both 독각귀살 and 독각살귀 as “One-Legged Ghost Killer”; they are used for the same possibly identified assassin.
